name: Track salary ranges on Lever job boards in Google Sheets and Slack with Apify

parameters.content:
## Track salary ranges on Lever job boards in Google Sheets and Slack

### How it works
Pay-transparency laws mean many companies now publish salary ranges on their Lever job boards. This workflow watches the boards you list (yours or competitors'), keeps only postings with a numeric salary, and builds a salary register in Google Sheets: title, team, location, remote/hybrid, min, max, currency and pay interval. New postings since the last run are posted to Slack as one digest, highest paying first. Use it for compensation benchmarking, recruiting research or a job alert.

Postings are matched by Lever posting ID, so repeated runs add only new jobs. On the first run every matching posting counts as new.

The Apify step runs the paid Apify Actor "Lever Jobs Scraper - Salary Ranges & Remote Filters", published by this template's author (Apify Store: ahmed.fouaad82/lever-salary-jobs). It reads Lever's public postings API. The first 25 saved jobs of every run are free; beyond that it is pay-per-job (see the Actor's Pricing tab). `maxCostPerRunUsd` caps one run's charges.

### Setup
1. Apify: create a free account and an n8n **Header Auth** credential: Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer {{APIFY_TOKEN}}` (your token). Select it in **Fetch Lever jobs with salaries**.
2. Google Sheets: connect your credential in both Sheets nodes and create a tab `Salary watch` with header row: `jobId, board, title, team, department, location, workplaceType, commitment, salaryMin, salaryMax, salaryCurrency, salaryInterval, salaryRange, postedAt, jobUrl, firstSeenAt`.
3. Slack: connect your credential and set `slackChannel`.
4. In **Job watch settings** enter Lever board slugs (the `acme` in jobs.lever.co/acme), then click **Run now**.

### Customization
Set `minSalary` with an exact currency and interval (no currency conversion), or `remoteOnly` = true. Global Lever boards only; jobs.eu.lever.co boards are not supported.

## 1. Settings and checks
Edit only **Job watch settings**. Board URLs are converted to slugs; invalid settings stop the run before any paid work.

## 2. Fetch salaried postings
One synchronous Apify run returns postings that publish a salary. A failed run stops with the reason and changes nothing.

## 3. New postings to Sheets and Slack
Known posting IDs are skipped. New ones are appended to the sheet and summarised in one Slack message.

### Cost cap
`maxCostPerRunUsd` is sent to Apify as the run's charge limit. Keep `maxJobsPerRun` at 25 to stay inside the free slice.
